title: feat(studio): design an object's public forms in Studio's Form tab
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8KF3BvUnBEoN52Vcnw6JhXg)_

Fixes #36444. This PR is the card's **Studio = design** half (ruling items 1–5 of https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/36444#issuecomment-7100386248). The **Settings = operations** half landed in #36697. It also carries #36697's round-3 follow-ups N9, N10 and N12 (record 7113373743).

Clause-②: yes (widening) — new Studio language-pack keys (`engine.studio.data.form.surface*` and the `engine.studio.publicForms.*` block) in en and zh; `@objectstack/spec` ships a corrected docblock for `anonymousFormIntakeWithdrawnIn` (prose only, no export or behaviour changes)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- Studio › 数据 › 对象 › 表单 新增「对外表单」：在对象下直接新建、删除对外表单，挑选字段（只列可填写的字段）、拖动排序、设必填、分组，设置标题、说明、提交后提示语和地址，右侧实时预览。
- 对象必填的字段不能从表单移除，并说明原因；地址被其他表单占用时（包括已关闭的表单）拒绝保存并提示。
- 保存走草稿 → 发布；已安装应用自带的表单存为本环境的定制，不改应用本身；应用自带的表单不能删除，需关闭请到 设置 › 对外表单。
- 应用发布时就关闭的表单，设计器列表里显示「已关闭（应用自带关闭）」，不会显示为开启。

## What changes

- **Studio → Data → an object → Form** now switches between the **Record form** (the New and Edit dialogs' layout, as before) and the object's **Public forms** (`formSurfaceControl` in the Form tab's toolbar, `data-form-surface`). No new tab: the Data pillar keeps its seven (objectui#12450).
- **The designer** (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/publicForm/PublicFormsDesigner.tsx`) lists the object's public forms, published and only drafted, and:
  - creates one from a title and an address; a new form starts with one section holding the fields the object requires, and is saved as `<object>.<address>`; a name any other view item of the environment already has (a list view such as `crm_lead.all`, the record form, a draft) is refused like a used address;
  - deletes one;
  - picks fields from the object's fillable ones only: never a hidden, read-only, system, formula, roll-up or auto-number field;
  - reorders fields by dragging or with the move buttons, marks them required, and groups them into named sections;
  - sets the title, description, after-submit heading and message (`submitBehavior: { kind: 'thank-you' }`, removed when cleared) and the address;
  - shows the form live as it is edited, rendered by the runtime `ObjectForm` from the sections being edited.
- **The rules** (`publicFormDesign.ts`, pure, unit-tested):
  - A field the object requires cannot be removed and stays required on the form. "Requires" means `required: true` with no `defaultValue` and no default option, so a field the write path fills in (app-crm's lead `status`, default `new`) is not held.
  - An address must be 2–64 characters of lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, and must not be used by another form, switched-off forms included. A clash is refused with a message and nothing is saved.
  - A saved design keeps every key it did not edit (`publicFormItemOf`), so the served rule (`anonymousFormIntakeCandidates`) still opens it at the same address. That includes the shapes the spec allows besides the plain one: a section stored without a `name` is matched by the same positional key the designer gave it (`section_<n>`, never one another section uses), so its description, columns, collapse and visibility keys stay; a field moved to another section keeps its own entry keys; a title, description, after-submit text or section label the person did not change is kept as stored, including one stored as a map of translations. No column count is written onto a section that had none.
- **Saves follow draft → publish**, as Studio's other designers do:
  - a form of a writable package is saved in that package;
  - on an installed app, a form the app ships is saved as a declared override in the app's customization package (ADR-0146 D2/D3, `overrideDraftBody`), never in the app; a new form goes into the customization package (`customization.ensure()`);
  - a form the app ships cannot be deleted; the designer says to switch it off in Setup → Public forms instead;
  - a draft written meanwhile is never overwritten (`ifNoneMatch: '*'` on a form with no draft).
- Switching a form on or off stays Setup's: the save no longer writes the form's on/off switch from a stale read. The stored shape is the form view item it always was (`viewKind: 'form'`, `config.sharing`); no key is added. Access restrictions (password, expiry, domains) are not offered, per the ruling.
- Setup → Public forms now names a form by the designer's rule (`publicFormShownName`): its label, else its title, else its first section's label, else its key.
- **#36697 follow-ups:**
  - The designer's list reads an installed app's forms the way Setup does (`markShippedOff`, now generic over the row shape): a form its app ships withdrawn is listed "Off (its app ships it off)", never On; a form whose app document cannot be read is listed "Unknown" (review M1/S2/N5, applied to Studio).
  - N12: on Setup → Public forms, an Unknown row offers no switch; Refresh reads it again.
  - N9: `anonymousFormIntakeWithdrawnIn`'s docblock in `packages/spec/src/ui/anonymous-form-intake.ts` names its real callers (the anonymous form doors, the v18 organization-ownership migration, the console's Setup page) and drops the organization-scoped write door that no longer calls it. Prose only.
  - N10: `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/access-security.json` points `anonymousFormIntakeWithdrawnIn` and `anonymousFormExplicitWithdrawals` at their new source, `packages/spec/src/ui/anonymous-form-intake.ts`.

## Boundaries

- **Developer → Public Forms (`nav_public_forms`) stays as it is in this PR.** Ruling item 1 says that page is upgraded into the designer; this PR builds the designer under the object (Studio → Data → an object → Form → Public forms) and does not remove, redirect or change the Developer page. Retiring it or pointing it at the designer is a follow-up for the card.
- **A designer draft holds Setup's switch.** Setup's on/off switch refuses over a pending draft (#36697's pending-draft rule), so a public form left saved-but-unpublished in Studio cannot be switched in Setup → Public forms until that draft is published or discarded. Setup says so when it refuses.
- **Known limits** (review N4–N6, not changed here):
  - Opening a form that has a pending draft loads that draft, shows "Draft saved" and offers Publish, whoever saved it: Studio's ordinary draft → publish. The chip does not say the draft may be another person's (N5).
  - The address check sees the published list and this object's draft-only forms, not another object's draft-only form or a pending draft that moves a published form's address, so two drafts can claim one address until one is published (N4).
  - Delete is withheld only for a form the open object's own app ships; a form of the object shipped by another read-only package relies on the server's refusal (N6).

## Tests

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/publicForm/publicFormDesign.test.ts` (24 cases): fillable fields (hidden, read-only, system, formula, summary, autonumber excluded; `fields` as an array); object-required fields, with a default value or default choice not held; reading a stored form (title, address, sections, required marks); writing back only what was edited, keeping every other key, dropping `_` decorations, the served rule still opening it at the same address; the thank-you panel written and removed; a non-thank-you submit behaviour kept; a new form's name, sections and served candidate; addresses from titles; the address rule (empty, shape, taken including switched-off forms, the form's own address); the field edits (refused removal of a required field, required kept, add once, move within and across sections, sections added, moved and removed keeping their fields); missing required fields; the preview's sections; a section stored without a name keeping every key, its field entries' keys and a moved field's keys; an unnamed section keyed apart from a section named like its place; titles, description, section labels and thank-you texts stored as translation maps kept when not edited and replaced when edited; no column count written onto a section that had none.
- `PublicFormsDesigner.test.tsx` (11 cases, rendered over a metadata client double): the list (published and drafted, not internal or another object's forms); the HotCRM edit on an installed app's form (Phone required, Title removed, new title) saved as a draft in the customization package declaring the override, then published there, the app's own package never written; the required-field refusal with its reason; a new form with four fields; a duplicate address refused with nothing saved; a named section; delete refused for the app's form and done for a writable package's; a form its app ships switched off listed as off even under an override that switches it on; a new form named like the object's list view (`crm_lead.all`) or record form refused, a free name accepted; the save and the publish carrying the on/off switch as stored at that time; a draft that already carries it published without a second save.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/PublicFormsSetupPage.test.tsx`: the Unknown row's switch is disabled (N12).
- Ablations: removing `markShippedOff` from the designer's list, or the Unknown condition from the Setup switch, each turns one case red.

## Acceptance notes

Live run on `examples/app-crm` (`objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`) + console dev server, as the seeded admin. `com.example.crm` is installed read-only, so this exercised the customization path. This was run before the rebase onto `main` at the Part 1 head; the code paths it walked are unchanged by the follow-ups except for the list's shipped-off mark, which is unit- and render-tested.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| Studio → Data → Lead → Form → Public forms | "Contact us" listed, On; the editor and live preview open |
| Remove the required "Lead Name" | refused, with the reason on screen |
| Make Phone required, remove Title, change the title to "Talk to sales", save, publish | saved as an override in `com.example.crm.custom`; `GET /api/v1/forms/contact-us` serves the new title and fields |
| Create "Demo signup" at `contact-us` | refused: the address is used by another form |
| Create "Demo signup" at `demo-signup` with name, company, email, and phone in an "About you" section, with a thank-you message | published; `GET /api/v1/forms/demo-signup` → 200; `/f/demo-signup` renders anonymously |
| Setup → Public forms | both forms listed |

Screenshots (live run, 2× scale) are in the project's shared files under `issue-36444/`; they cannot be uploaded to GitHub from the cloud seat:
- `11-studio-designer-open.png`: the designer on Lead's "Contact us", with the preview.
- `12-studio-required-refused.png`: removing a required field refused, with the reason.
- `13-studio-designer-edited.png`: Phone required, Title removed, the new title.
- `14-studio-duplicate-address.png`: a used address refused.
- `15-studio-new-form.png`: "Demo signup" with its two sections.
- `16-studio-list-after.png`: the designer's list after both changes.
- `17-anon-demo-signup.png`: the new form at its anonymous address.
- `18-setup-after-studio.png`: Setup → Public forms listing both.

Known: the preview's footer shows the runtime form's own Cancel and Create buttons, not the anonymous page's Submit.

## Verification

Head `5e8aaa4bc0`: the squashed Part 2 commit `90ed3338c3`, the fix commit `80ebf09091` and the review-fix commit `5e8aaa4bc0` (S1–S3 and N3 of contract review 7117275850), on `main` `d59d875114` (which includes #36697 as `c45dd80ff9`).

- `5e8aaa4bc0`:
  - the public form designer suites: 35 passed (24 rule cases, 11 rendered); of the seven new cases, the six that pin S1–S3 and N3 fail on `80ebf09091`'s code (checked by swapping the two source files back); the seventh, no second save when the draft already carries the switch, guards the publish path;
  - `@object-ui/app-shell` type-check (src + tests): exit 0; ESLint on the designer folder: 0 errors;
  - `check-vi-mock-inherit`, `check-vi-mock-override-shape`, `check-new-cross-file-line-citations`, `check-control-bytes`, `check-i18n-call-site-keys`, `pnpm check:platform-checklist`: exit 0. The derived gate list is the same 90 commands as at `80ebf09091`, and this commit touches only the four designer files;
  - CI: all 70 check-runs completed — 60 success, 10 skipped (opt-in, queue and schedule gates), 0 failure.
- Earlier, on `90ed3338c3`/`80ebf09091`: the derived gate union (`dispatch-gates --commands`, 90 commands) ran 88 exit 0 on `90ed3338c3`; the two that did not (`pnpm check:platform-checklist`, stale checklist anchors; `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`, the designer test's `@object-ui/plugin-form` mock not spreading `importOriginal()`) were fixed in `80ebf09091`. CI on `80ebf09091`: 60 success, 10 skipped, 0 failure. `peopleAssignments.navContribution.test.tsx` ("Position holders" heading) fails locally on `main` too and is green in CI; not touched here.
- os-dev report (at `80ebf09091`): https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/36444#issuecomment-7117131692
